upstreamName: OpenCode TUI (packages/tui) + SDK v2 types + plugin/tui types

vendoredPaths.vendor/opencode-tui: packages/tui/src (185 files, tree sha256 63a5258d… at copy time)

uptokeyShims.vendor/opencode-core/*: minimal re-implementations of @opencode-ai/core/{global,flag,version,open,which,flock,glob} and @opencode-ai/ui/audio stub; state in ~/.uptokey/tui

opentui.nativePrebuilt: @opentui/core-win32-x64 opentui.dll (3,786,120 bytes) loaded on this host under Smart App Control

localModifications.reason: OpenCode HTTP/SSE client replaced by the in-process Uptokey backend (uptokey/backend); frame-window event batching kept; Events emitted in the same tick are applied in one batch (microtask), so a resync never renders a frame with messages removed
Decisions raised by the Uptokey controller (metadata.uptokey) are never auto-approved by the UI auto-permission toggle; Startup milestone traced (debug log only)
DialogProvider renders the Uptokey provider onboarding (setup service, masked key, discovery)
OpenCode wordmark replaced by the Uptokey mark and wordmark
uptokey_* decisions use the Uptokey review/approval prompt; Prompt exported
uptokey_* tool parts use Uptokey views; InlineTool/BlockTool exported; Plural forms chosen before translation (line/lines, question/questions)
unused copy (plugin runtime is not used); kept only because it was copied with tui.ts
Folder-mention confirmation before send; localized placeholder and paste summary; slash commands on the home screen run without creating an empty conversation
Plural form chosen before translation (Permission/Permissions)
Plural form chosen before translation (error/errors)
Group labels use the interface language (Today, localized date) and translated action titles
Times and dates formatted in the interface language instead of the host locale
Key binding descriptions looked up through tr() for the which-key overlay

Theme-mode wait bounded (waitForThemeMode 150 ms) and Uptokey commands registered; strings wrapped with tr(); waitForThemeMode bounded to 60 ms; startup milestones traced only when UPTOKEY_TUI_DEBUG_LOG is set
Uptokey key bindings registered alongside the upstream map

User-visible strings wrapped with tr() by scripts/localize-vendor.mjs (English source kept as key). Exact file list, upstream/local sha256 and changed-line counts: UPSTREAM-DIFF.json (scripts/upstream-diff.mjs against the pinned clone)
A built-in theme other than system is ready at once; the terminal palette query (unanswered by ConPTY) no longer holds the first frame
Prompts typed in a temporary conversation stay in memory only (never written to prompt-history.jsonl)
Prompts stashed in a temporary conversation stay in memory only (never written to prompt-stash.jsonl)
A command being submitted may move the window (/projetos switches folder and shows its home) before the input is cleared: what was just sent is not stashed and restored as a draft in the next prompt

A click on the prompt padding focuses the input, and the prompt reclaims the focus when it is blurred with nothing else focused (no dialog): before, one click left the keyboard on nothing and every key was dropped

Uptokey theme: product palette (Dodger Blue 017AFF, Neon 6C47FF, Turquoise 39C0C8, Safety Orange F96300, Wild Melon F34971, Coral FF9382, Amber F5C900, Tan CDAD7A, Celery AABB5D) on the OpenCode theme structure
Registers the uptokey theme
Default theme is uptokey (a theme the person chose is kept)
The active sidebar footer fallback displays the Uptokey product wordmark with the canonical package version; upstream module identifiers and MIT notices are preserved.

Earlier-messages paging compensates the prepended height from scrollTop (the reading position) instead of the box's screen y, waits until the new page is measured, and PageUp loads only at the real top. Found by the native history journey: the view jumped 100 messages to the start of the loaded page.

The search field also takes focus as soon as it is created (the deferred focus is kept). Keys typed while boot kept the event loop busy were dropped in the onboarding provider list (4 of 8 compiled runs needed retyping before, 0 of 8 after).

Reasoning parts now arrive from Uptokey: the reasoning body draws text before highlighting (drawUnstyledText) so it grows while the model thinks, and the Thought/Thinking/Collapse/Expand labels use tr() in ten languages.
Terminal tool non-execution remains neutral and visible rather than appearing successful, including when successful tool details are collapsed.

note: Local modifications to vendored files are appended to localModifications with file, reason and date; unmodified files must keep upstream bytes so upstream updates can be diffed.
